Safety: estop=FALSE turns all actuator outputs off immediately. "Emergency stop resets all manual latches and automatic state. A fresh autoStart edge is required to restart." Edge history updates during emergency stop so held buttons cannot restart outputs on recovery. This implies on every scan, track previous button states, even during estop and mode change. Manual latches are likely output states or separate manual latches? Outputs must be false under estop, but latches reset. On recovery while held, no toggle. So manual controls can toggle from false. Could use outputs as latches but estop forces false. Easier have manual latch vars? The output is command and can remain true in manual. Automatic drives outputs based phase. Mode change clears old latches and sequence, suppresses commands for that invocation. We can unify outputs as state? But outputs in FB likely retain values when assigned. Need ensure all output assignment each scan.

We need account for mode-change first invocation behavior. There are no timestamps, but first invocation must establish selected mode and execute normally. Need `initialized` bool or `firstScan`. Inputs scanned. Could declare `initialized : BOOL := FALSE; previousMode : BOOL; modeChanged : BOOL;`. Each call:
- Compute rising edges from stored previous input states before update.
- Determine modeChanged: initialized AND opeMode <> previousMode. On very first invocation modeChanged=false, set previousMode := opeMode; initialized:=TRUE.
- Edge histories update always.
- If mode change: clear sequence and latches, suppress all commands this scan. Estop? priority estop first. If both estop false and mode changed, estop also off. Edge memories update. Need all outputs false on mode change per P8.
- E-stop check: if NOT estop: off, reset manual latches, phase IDLE, maybe latched batch mode etc, auto fresh edge requirement. Need also perhaps suppress autoStart edge? Assumption says fresh autoStart edge required after emergency stop; edge history updates during emergency stop so if autoStart held during estop and still held after recovery, no rising edge. If autoStart rising during estop, its previous will update so after recovery requires new rising. Using edge detection every scan handles. But what if autoStart rises exactly on same scan estop false? Since estop dominates, edge still consumed, no auto start. Next scan no edge. Good.
- Mode change: clears latches and sequence, suppresses commands, edge memories still update. If autoStart rises same mode-change scan, consumed.

When no estop and no mode change: mode behavior.
Manual: opeMode false. Each button rising toggles corresponding output. All independent can coexist? Safety priority says automatic phases drive only one actuator; independent manual toggles may coexist. But P8 only auto one actuator; P7 manual independent. So manual can multiple outputs simultaneously. Need all ignored in automatic. "Changing operation mode clears old latches and sequence." So manual latches reset upon mode switch. In manual, outputs exactly manual latch booleans. Auto outputs set according phase.

Automatic: opeMode true. Start auto process on autoStart rising edge accepted in IDLE or DRAIN. It starts fresh batch from FILL_A. processMode stays latched for active batch phases 1..5. When level >=50, close A and open B (phase FILL_B) same scan. Then >=80: if batch mode false, transition to MIX and start motor; if true, transition FILL_C and open C. Then in FILL_C when level >=100, transition MIX, start motor. In MIX when mixMotorComplete true, stop motor, open D, phase DRAIN. DRAIN stays D until estop, manual mode, or fresh autoStart rising. If fresh autoStart in DRAIN, start from FILL_A in same invocation. Automatic ends with D open; is phase DRAIN not IDLE. Requirement "automatic process ends" but assumption says DRAIN remains true until conditions. So state remains DRAIN.

Need one actuator only in auto. D only on DRAIN. In IDLE no outputs.

// Default outputs? We need always assign.

IF NOT estop THEN

    modeChanged maybe don't reset? not relevant. 
ELSIF modeChanged THEN

    batchMode := FALSE;
    manual... := FALSE;
    outputs false;
ELSIF opeMode THEN
    // automatic
    // reset manual latches? Mode change already clears, but while auto, force manual latches false? They may still hold from prior first auto invocation? At first invocation auto no latches. Switch clears. Could keep false.
    // default outputs? Better compute from phase
    CASE phase OF
      IDLE:
        all outputs false;
        IF riseAutoStart THEN
           batchMode := processMode;
           phase := FILL_A;
           valveARun := TRUE; // one transition
        END_IF
      DRAIN:
        valveDRun := TRUE; // initial assumption
        IF riseAutoStart THEN
           batchMode := processMode;
           phase := FILL_A;
           valveDRun := FALSE;
           valveARun := TRUE;
        END_IF
      FILL_A:
        valveARun := TRUE;
        IF levelSensor >= 50 THEN
           valveARun := FALSE;
           valveBRun := TRUE;
           phase := FILL_B;
        END_IF
      FILL_B:
        valveBRun := TRUE;
        IF levelSensor >= 80 THEN
           valveBRun := FALSE;
           IF batchMode THEN
             valveCRun := TRUE;
             phase := FILL_C;
           ELSE
             mixMotorRun := TRUE;
             phase := MIX;
           END_IF
        END_IF
      FILL_C:
        valveCRun := TRUE;
        IF levelSensor >= 100 THEN
           valveCRun := FALSE;
           mixMotorRun := TRUE;
           phase := MIX;
        END_IF
      MIX:
        mixMotorRun := TRUE;
        IF mixMotorComplete THEN
           mixMotorRun := FALSE;
           valveDRun := TRUE;
           phase := DRAIN;
        END_IF
    END_CASE
ELSE
    // manual
    // outputs from latches
    // update latches on edges
    IF riseValveAStart THEN manualValveA := NOT manualValveA; END_IF
...
    outputs := latches
END_IF
